---
title: "API"
---

The API should support whole-pipeline runs, stage-limited runs, and explicit single-stage calls.

## Command-line examples

Run the full pipeline:

```bash
ephys-pipeline run --config pipeline.yaml --output pipeline_run
```

Run only through preprocessing on a short time slice:

```bash
ephys-pipeline run --config pipeline.yaml --output debug_run --until preprocessing --debug-time-slice 0:120
```

Run one stage explicitly:

```bash
ephys-pipeline raw-quality --config pipeline.yaml --output pipeline_run
```

## Python API examples

A user setting up for the first time with a fast preprocessing iteration cycle:

```python
recordings = ["/path/to/session_001", "/path/to/session_002"]

preprocess(
    recordings,
    output_path="debug_preprocessing",
    time_slice="0:120",
    save_recording=False,
)
```

A user checking raw data quality metrics:

```python
recordings = ["/path/to/session_001"]
raw_data_metrics(recordings, output_path="raw_quality")
```

A user manually curating saturation artifacts:

```python
recordings = ["/path/to/session_001"]
detections = detect_artifacts(recordings, output_path="artifact_detection")
curate_artifacts(detections, output_path="artifact_curation", gui="viewephys")
```
